hypothesis: Publicly announced Broadcom customer deployment commitments are sufficient to support the prior 7.83910862% post-FY2028 total-revenue CAGR assumption through FY2031.
capital_allocation_importance: The prior AVGO-vs-NVDA stress study found that, after assuming FY2027 AI semiconductor revenue of 115B USD and FY2028 of 230B USD, AVGO required post-FY2028 total-revenue CAGR of 7.83910862% to match the NVIDIA canonical base case under explicit downside stress. If customer commitments do not extend through the full FY2029-FY2031 interval, that CAGR cannot be treated as evidence-backed.

precommitted_decision_rule.USE: Explicit customer deployment or contracted capacity evidence extends through FY2031 or later and directly covers Broadcom XPU/networking demand.
precommitted_decision_rule.CONDITION: Explicit evidence extends through FY2030 but not FY2031.
precommitted_decision_rule.REJECT: The latest explicit dated customer deployment evidence ends in FY2029 or earlier, leaving two or more years of the required FY2029-FY2031 interval unsupported.

primary_evidence.fact: 10GW of OpenAI-designed accelerators and Broadcom networking systems; deployment targeted to start in 2H 2026 and complete by end of 2029.

AI XPV Platform designed to enable more than 20GW of compute capacity using Broadcom XPUs and networking for frontier AI labs through 2028; initial 35B USD infrastructure tranche supports more than 1GW.
primary_evidence.unit_warning: 35B USD is infrastructure transaction value, not Broadcom revenue.

primary_evidence.fact: Multi-year, multi-generation MTIA partnership, with plans to extend through 2029; initial commitment exceeds 1GW and the parties plan multi-gigawatt rollout.

verification_method.method: Point-in-time horizon coverage test using only dated issuer announcements. No GW-to-revenue conversion and no inferred renewal beyond explicit deployment horizons.
verification_method.benchmark: Prior deterministic post-FY2028 CAGR assumption of 7.83910862% for FY2029-FY2031.
verification_method.alternative: Require explicit dated customer/deployment evidence for each forward year before treating the CAGR as evidence-backed.

interpretation: The current public evidence strongly supports Broadcom AI deployment visibility into 2028-2029, but it does not provide dated customer deployment commitments for 2030-2031. Therefore 7.83910862% cannot be promoted from a sensitivity boundary to a deterministic evidence-backed post-FY2028 growth assumption. This does not reject Broadcom, the customer projects, or the possibility of growth beyond 2029; it rejects the sufficiency of current public commitments for the full FY2029-FY2031 valuation horizon.

risk_metrics.reason: This is a forward fundamental evidence-horizon test, not a return-series backtest.

implementation.usage_rule: Do not use 7.83910862% as an evidence-backed deterministic FY2029-FY2031 growth assumption. Keep it only as a break-even sensitivity boundary until 2030-2031 demand evidence exists.

remaining_uncertainty: Publicly announced projects may be renewed, expanded, or supplemented after 2029, but no dated 2030-2031 Broadcom customer deployment commitment was verified in this run. Absence of public evidence is not evidence of zero demand.
next_hypothesis: A probability-weighted AVGO valuation that treats FY2030-FY2031 growth as an explicit scenario distribution, rather than a deterministic 7.83910862% assumption, produces a materially different expected 5-year return versus NVIDIA after margin, dilution, and terminal-multiple stress.
